name: apple-reminders
description: Use the local macOS Reminders app from Codex to list, search, create, update, complete, and delete reminders.

interface.longDescription: Apple Reminders connects Codex to the local macOS Reminders app. Read your lists, search open reminders, and create or manage reminders without sending data to a cloud service.
